class.name: CgameAimModifier3D
class.brief_description: Aims a bone axis at a target with an angular limit.
class.description: [CgameAimModifier3D] rotates one bone so that its [member forward_axis] points at a target, limited to [member max_angle] degrees from the animated direction and scaled by [member SkeletonModifier3D.influence]. The target is either the [Node3D] at [member target_node] or [member target_position] in skeleton space. This class is distinct from the engine's [AimModifier3D], which is a bone constraint that aims at a reference bone.

members.member: Name of the bone to rotate.
Bone-local axis that is aimed at the target.
Maximum rotation in degrees away from the animated direction.
Node3D to aim at when [member use_target_node] is enabled.
Target in skeleton space when [member use_target_node] is disabled.
If [code]true[/code], aims at [member target_node], otherwise at [member target_position].
